slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

the 24 hour yes

say yes to the first invitation you get this week, before your brain lists the reasons not to. most of the good stories in your life started with a plan you almost skipped.

the shared table

once a week, sit at a shared table or a busy bench instead of the empty one. being comfortable near strangers is a quiet skill, and it shows in every room you walk into.

owning your laugh

for one week, laugh out loud when something is funny, no covering your mouth, no holding back. people who take up space with joy are the ones everyone wants around.

daily trivia

learn one piece of trivia a day in 5 minutes: a weird animal fact, a history twist, the story behind a painting. having something fun to share makes walking up to people feel easy.

learn one piece of trivia a day in 5 minutes: a weird animal fact, a history twist. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and you'll always have something fun to share.

giving a toast

next time there's a birthday or a dinner, stand up and say a few words. 30 seconds of being the voice of the room teaches you more than any book about confidence.
